title: Heavenly Demon Instructor
altTitles: My Master Is a Backseat Gamer
ปรมาจารย์เทวบุตรมาร
description: After the Portal Impact devastates Earth and leaves Park Hyunsoo responsible for his unconscious younger sibling, he struggles as a powerless support in a world overrun by monsters. His life changes when Chungyeong, a martial arts master from the Murim world, appears before him and becomes his teacher. Guided by the Heavenly Demon, Hyunsoo begins learning martial arts and gaining the strength needed to survive the dangerous world around him.
author: Hwabong, Kim Jaka
